goals.name: Code Refactor Session Goal Harness
goals.description: Code Refactor Session Goal Harness [code-refactor-session] — compiled from capabilities/harnesses/hA-02-code-refactor.yaml
goals.gate: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events

gates.name: 0.1 Startup phrase spoken and refactor target pinned to a file l
gates.description: Startup phrase spoken and refactor target pinned to a file list plus a stated behavior-preservation claim
gates.command: Session log contains the file list and the one-sentence behavior claim

gates.name: 0.2 Procedures declared mandatory: characterization tests before
gates.description: Procedures declared mandatory: characterization tests before transforms, one pattern per pass, parity proof after every pass
gates.command: Session preamble names all three procedures verbatim

gates.name: 0.3 RIG coordinate stated before the first edit
gates.description: RIG coordinate stated before the first edit
gates.command: Session log line 'COORD: L2-L4 x D1-D3 x A1/A2 x IQRSQPI'

gates.name: 0.4 Harness tuple H_refactor(behavior_lock, transform_steps, par
gates.description: Harness tuple H_refactor(behavior_lock, transform_steps, parity_proof, improvement) declared
gates.command: Tuple declaration present in session log

gates.name: 1.1 Green baseline before any edit: full test suite run and exit
gates.description: Green baseline before any edit: full test suite run and exit code 0 recorded; a red baseline converts the session to a bug-fix session, not a refactor
gates.command: Exit code + summary tail in .rig/refactor/baseline.txt; if red, session log records the conversion decision

gates.name: 1.2 Characterization coverage for touch points: every function i
gates.description: Characterization coverage for touch points: every function in the refactor file list that lacks a covering test gets a characterization test capturing current behavior BEFORE the first transform
gates.command: git diff of the test-only pre-commit at .rig/refactor/char-tests.diff; commit SHA of the pre-commit recorded

gates.name: 1.3 Public API surface snapshot: exported symbols enumerated (ts
gates.description: Public API surface snapshot: exported symbols enumerated (ts-prune, go doc, pydoc, or hand list) before edits so the post-refactor surface can be diffed
gates.command: .rig/refactor/api-surface-before.txt exists and is non-empty for every touched package

gates.name: 2.1 One pattern per pass: each commit applies exactly one named
gates.description: One pattern per pass: each commit applies exactly one named refactoring (extract function, rename, inline, move module...) — no mixed-mechanics commits
gates.command: git log --oneline for the session where each commit message names exactly one refactoring pattern; mixed commits are flagged in session log

gates.name: 2.2 Behavior parity proof after every pass: test suite re-run af
gates.description: Behavior parity proof after every pass: test suite re-run after each commit and exit 0; any red run triggers immediate git revert of that pass before continuing
gates.command: Per-commit exit codes in .rig/refactor/parity-runs.txt with one 'PASS' line per commit SHA

gates.name: 2.3 Mechanical transforms use AST-aware tooling where available
gates.description: Mechanical transforms use AST-aware tooling where available (ast-grep, ts-morph, gofmt -r, comby) rather than regex or hand-edits for rename/move shapes
gates.command: Transform commands recorded in .rig/refactor/transforms.log; hand-edit exceptions each carry a one-line justification

gates.name: 2.4 Diff size discipline: no single commit exceeds 400 changed l
gates.description: Diff size discipline: no single commit exceeds 400 changed lines; larger transforms are split into preparatory + application commits
gates.command: git log --stat per session commit; any >400-line commit is explicitly justified in the session log or split

gates.name: 3.1 Public API surface unchanged (or every change is deliberate
gates.description: Public API surface unchanged (or every change is deliberate and listed): post-refactor symbol dump diffed against api-surface-before.txt
gates.command: diff .rig/refactor/api-surface-before.txt .rig/refactor/api-surface-after.txt output attached; each delta annotated 'deliberate: <reason>'

gates.name: 3.2 No stale artifacts: dead code, commented-out blocks, and orp
gates.description: No stale artifacts: dead code, commented-out blocks, and orphaned imports introduced or left by the refactor are removed; knip/deadcode/vulture run shows no new dead symbols in touched packages
gates.command: Dead-code tool output attached with zero new entries vs the pre-refactor run

gates.name: 3.3 No sneaked-in behavior changes: diff manually scanned for lo
gates.description: No sneaked-in behavior changes: diff manually scanned for logic edits disguised as refactors (default-value changes, reordering of side effects, error-message text changes)
gates.command: Session log section 'behavior-delta scan' states clean, or lists each delta with a pointer to its approved gate

gates.name: 3.4 Full-suite final green + lint + typecheck all exit 0 on the
gates.description: Full-suite final green + lint + typecheck all exit 0 on the final tree, not on any intermediate commit
gates.command: Three exit codes recorded in .rig/refactor/final-green.txt with the final HEAD SHA

gates.name: 4.1 Refactor summary written: motivation, pattern list, risk reg
gates.description: Refactor summary written: motivation, pattern list, risk register (what could still be different), and rollback commit range
gates.command: .rig/refactor/summary.md exists with all four sections; rollback range is a valid git range verified with git log

gates.name: 4.2 Improvement entry written: one observed code-smell pattern w
gates.description: Improvement entry written: one observed code-smell pattern worth a lint rule, or one harness gap

preconditions.startup_phrase: I change the shape of the code, never its behavior, and I prove it.
preconditions.bms_bias: A1 for verification of behavior parity; A2 for mechanical transforms; A3 for naming only; A4 forbidden

self_improvement.update_trigger: same gate fails 3+ times → promote the check to an AST lint rule or tighten the gate proof

success_conditions: All gates passed or degraded-with-log; zero unresolved halt gates, zero stop events
Final tree green across tests, lint, typecheck with recorded exit codes
API surface delta is empty or fully annotated deliberate
summary.md with rollback range committed alongside the refactor
Identity closure: coordinate, parity verdict, next safe action stated
failure_states: notes: no stop-tier gates in a local refactor; a red parity run is a halt that resolves by revert, never by force
halt gate(s) 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 2.1, 2.2, 3.1, 3.3, 3.4, 4.1, 4.2: no progress without gate evidence
degrade gate(s) 2.3, 2.4, 3.2: continue with deficit logged in the Definition of Done waiver
quality_criteria: Startup phrase spoken and refactor target pinned to a file list plus a stated behavior-preservation claim
Procedures declared mandatory: characterization tests before transforms, one pattern per pass, parity proof after every pass
RIG coordinate stated before the first edit
Harness tuple H_refactor(behavior_lock, transform_steps, parity_proof, improvement) declared
Green baseline before any edit: full test suite run and exit code 0 recorded; a red baseline converts the session to a bug-fix session, not a refactor
Characterization coverage for touch points: every function in the refactor file list that lacks a covering test gets a characterization test capturing current behavior BEFORE the first transform
Public API surface snapshot: exported symbols enumerated (ts-prune, go doc, pydoc, or hand list) before edits so the post-refactor surface can be diffed
One pattern per pass: each commit applies exactly one named refactoring (extract function, rename, inline, move module...) — no mixed-mechanics commits
Behavior parity proof after every pass: test suite re-run after each commit and exit 0; any red run triggers immediate git revert of that pass before continuing
Mechanical transforms use AST-aware tooling where available (ast-grep, ts-morph, gofmt -r, comby) rather than regex or hand-edits for rename/move shapes
Diff size discipline: no single commit exceeds 400 changed lines; larger transforms are split into preparatory + application commits
Public API surface unchanged (or every change is deliberate and listed): post-refactor symbol dump diffed against api-surface-before.txt
No stale artifacts: dead code, commented-out blocks, and orphaned imports introduced or left by the refactor are removed; knip/deadcode/vulture run shows no new dead symbols in touched packages
No sneaked-in behavior changes: diff manually scanned for logic edits disguised as refactors (default-value changes, reordering of side effects, error-message text changes)
Full-suite final green + lint + typecheck all exit 0 on the final tree, not on any intermediate commit
Refactor summary written: motivation, pattern list, risk register (what could still be different), and rollback commit range
Improvement entry written: one observed code-smell pattern worth a lint rule, or one harness gap

final_rule: Behavior lock before the first edit; no characterization, no refactor.
One pattern per pass, parity proof per pass.
A red test mid-refactor is answered with revert, never with hope.
No improvement entry, no session complete.
Every code-refactor session leaves the system stronger than it found it.

prose: notes: no stop-tier gates in a local refactor; a red parity run is a halt that resolves by revert, never by force
